title: Behind the scenes: a portal-access tick for each member in the company forms (switched off)
text: The formation and onboarding forms for multi-member companies can now ask, for each extra member, whether that person gets a client portal login for the company. The box starts ticked; unticking it keeps the person an owner on every document and only keeps the company out of their portal. The form also warns that whoever signs the SS-4 appears on the EIN letter. It is switched off, so no client sees any difference yet: we test it on test companies first and Antonio turns it on afterwards.
